claims.value: DeepSeek-V3.2-Exp is an experimental model built upon V3.1-Terminus by introducing DeepSeek Sparse Attention (DSA), a sparse attention mechanism designed to explore and validate optimizations for training and inference efficiency in long-context scenarios.
claims.evidence: DeepSeek Sparse Attention (DSA) achieves fine-grained sparse attention for the first time, delivering substantial improvements in long-context training and inference efficiency
vLLM provides day-0 support of DeepSeek-V3.2-Exp. See the recipes for up-to-date details.
DeepSeek-V3.2-Exp demonstrates performance on par with V3.1-Terminus.
